Hi again care crew,
The ramp lead sent an update on hand-off notes

Please tighten the review process for every companion animal transfer and keep the language plain with passengers. The senior coordinator wants each hand-off record to show who received the carrier, which checks were completed, and whether the animal stayed settled during the move. <<FACT F021>> When you brief a traveler, keep the tone calm and direct, and avoid adding anything that has not been confirmed by the desk.

For the next round of service, pay closer attention to species, temperament, and comfort cues before you release any case to the ramp team. If a pet shows stress, pause and route the matter back through the senior coordinator rather than improvise at the counter. Minnie, Theo Wilson, and Khalil Brown may be used as examples in training logs, but only when the case file already includes them. The goal is consistent handling, not speed for its own sake.

Please also check that notes passed from the lounge to the gate remain brief, readable, and complete. We need the same standard from every colleague on the floor so that Aurelia Skyways keeps a steady hand in Companion Animal Travel Desk service. Clear hand-offs prevent avoidable confusion, and they also help the next team member act without delay. Keep the record tidy, the wording factual, and the focus on the animal's comfort.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
